source_semantics.validation: RegisterAsync trims the username, validates registration through LocalAuthenticationService, and presents validation failure without mutation.
source_semantics.identity: A successful registration creates a durable application identity before subscription assignment.
source_semantics.trial: The source resolves the enabled free-trial plan and creates a trial subscription when no current subscription exists.
source_semantics.partial_failure: If free-trial lookup or assignment fails after identity creation, the account remains created and the user sees a truthful administrator-contact message.
source_semantics.success: Successful identity and trial creation redirects to /login?registered=true.

runtime_path: anonymous web request with CSRF protection
strict username/password validation and caller-owned identity rejection
transactional durable User + Tenant + TenantMembership + owner RBAC + immutable tenant audit creation
SubscriptionService::startTrial using the enabled free-trial plan
truthful account-created/trial-unavailable state when trial assignment fails

security.tenant_isolation: The client cannot supply tenant, user, role, plan, billing-plan, or trial ownership identifiers; the workspace tenant and membership are created server-side.
security.credentials: Passwords are validated server-side, stored through Laravel's hashed User cast, and never rendered back into the browser.
security.rbac: The new workspace receives an owner membership and explicit tenant-scoped permissions.
security.csrf: Both registration routes use the web middleware; POST is covered by Laravel CSRF validation.
security.cross_tenant_path: No tenant-selected registration route exists; /tenants/{foreign}/register is proven unavailable.

assertions: anonymous web route and canonical operation binding
foreign tenant path is 404 and caller ownership injection is rejected
successful registration creates identity/workspace/RBAC/trial/audit and username login
free-trial failure preserves the created account while remaining truthful
